definitions.de: Etwas stopfen, verstopfen oder zustecken; eine Öffnung oder ein Loch verschließen
definitions.en: To plug, stuff, or block; to close or seal an opening or hole
definitions.es: Tapar, rellenar o bloquear; cerrar u obstruir una abertura o agujero
definitions.fr: Boucher, obstruer ou remplir; fermer ou colmater une ouverture ou un trou
definitions.hi: किसी छेद या खुले स्थान को बंद करना, ठूंसना या भरना
definitions.ja: 穴や開口部を塞ぐ、詰める、または塞ぎ止める
definitions.km: បិទ ដាក់ទ្រនុង ឬស្ទះ; បិទជិតរន្ធ ឬចន្លោះ
definitions.ko: 구멍이나 틈을 막다, 틀어막다, 또는 채워 넣다
definitions.ne: कुनै प्वाल वा खुला ठाउँ बन्द गर्नु, ठोस्नु वा भर्नु
definitions.pt: Tampar, entupir ou bloquear; fechar ou vedar uma abertura ou buraco
definitions.th: อุด ยัด หรืออุดกั้น; ปิดหรือปิดผนึกช่องเปิดหรือรู
definitions.tl: Tumapon, mag-ipit, o magtagpi; isara o tapunan ang isang butas o bukana
definitions.ur: کسی سوراخ یا کھلی جگہ کو بند کرنا، ٹھونسنا یا بھرنا
definitions.vi: Bịt, nhét hoặc chặn; đóng hoặc bịt kín một lỗ hổng hoặc khe hở
definitions.zh: 堵塞、填塞或封闭；关闭或密封一个开口或孔洞
definitions.zh_Hant: 堵塞、填塞或封閉；關閉或密封一個開口或孔洞

definition_en: To plug, stuff, or block; to close or seal an opening or hole

lao_examples.lao_script: ເອົາຜ້າອຸດຮູນັ້ນໄວ້ກ່ອນເດີ້
lao_examples.romanization: ao pha ut hu nan wai kon doe
lao_examples.translation_en: Use a cloth to plug that hole for now.

lao_examples.lao_script: ນ້ຳຊືມ ຕ້ອງອຸດໃຫ້ດີໆ
lao_examples.romanization: nam suem, tong ut hai di-di
lao_examples.translation_en: The water is leaking — it needs to be plugged up properly.
